## Adding New Terms

When introducing a new term or abbreviation in documentation:

1. Add it to this glossary with a clear definition
2. Reference this glossary in the document where the term is first used
3. Use consistent terminology across all documents

Example in a meeting record:

```markdown
* Current page load time: 450ms [See glossary: Page Load Time]
* Target load time: under 100ms measured as [TTC](#tbi) [See glossary: Time to Interactive]
```
